verdict.rationale: Runloop's own docs describe Devboxes as 'secure sandboxed execution environments' and 'isolated Linux sandbox environments', so it does claim isolation between sandboxes and the user's systems. Nothing in the pack names the boundary type (microVM, hypervisor, gVisor or similar) or explains the isolation architecture. Egress network policies and credential-hiding gateways are related controls, not the isolation boundary itself, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: documented isolation mechanism (microVM or equivalent), architecture/threat-model documentation of the boundary, independent or hands-on corroboration.
